cv.title: CV
cv.description: CV for Mikkel Nothlev Elvers, a junior web developer based in {{location}}, who builds whole products, from the database to the interface.
cv.profile: Junior web developer who builds whole products, from the database to the interface. I work in TypeScript across React, Next.js and SvelteKit on the frontend, and Express, Hono and PostgreSQL on the backend. I care about readable code, clear abstractions and understanding the technology behind what I ship.

projects.name: Sora
bullets: Built a self-hosted anime library on my own: a versioned HTTP API, a typed SDK, a SvelteKit web app and a job scheduler that keeps a catalogue of 12,000+ series up to date.
Built a stream proxy that only accepts encrypted, expiring tokens tied to one account, and fetches video segments ahead of time for smooth playback.
Wrote an algorithm that re-times subtitles for a different video version. Runs in production in three Docker containers, with over 400 automated tests.

projects.name: HiFi Horizon
bullets: Built a full-stack webshop where users browse, compare and buy hi-fi products.
Added search, filtering, product comparison, cart and checkout, login, user profiles and order history.
Built the Express API that connects the React frontend to the PostgreSQL database for users, products and orders.

projects.name: Newsify
bullets: Built a mobile news reader on The New York Times' Top Stories and Most Popular APIs, with articles grouped by category.
Added search with Fuse.js, data fetching with React Query and a swipe-based archive.
Saved the theme, chosen categories and archive between sessions.

projects.name: Escape Room
bullets: Team project for a school brief: a browser game where players fix a "compromised" bank website in five minutes by solving 10 short CSS puzzles, each revealing part of a lock code.
Frontend in React with Vite, GSAP animation, background music and a countdown timer.
Leaderboard server on Bun and Express with SQLite, with Zod-validated names, a banned-word filter and rate limiting.

education.name: Web Developer
education.grade: Graduated with the top grade, 12 on the Danish scale.
bullets: Focus on modern frontend development with React, Next.js, Vite, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, CSS and Tailwind CSS.
Connected the frontend to the backend through REST APIs, including setup and consumption.
Introduction to server-side development and CMSs, including WordPress and Strapi, plus basic PHP and MySQL.
